task_file.basis: Actual chunks consumed by evaluator; id/ep_idx/step_idx/qpos endpoints checked against canonical HDF5 for all six runs. List order indexes every outcomes array.

failed_prior_attempt.charge_basis: Conservative provider container start through verified zero GPU tasks. Includes startup/teardown uncertainty; excludes CPU preflight and provider queue. Actual worker elapsed separately reported.

supervisor_incident.provider_error: InternalFailure: Server has lost track of input
supervisor_incident.resolution: All six original worker calls completed and matched canonical runtimes. Owner reconciled artifacts and provider allocation directly; no redispatch or retry.

allocation_metadata.basis: Distinct owned GPU containers: provider startedAt to finishedAt, or current time if active; round up plus one second per container. Queue excluded. Reused containers counted once.

resource_accounting.output_size_basis: V2 canonical output listing plus334518bytes retained v1 evidence and the final owner archive; later publication receipts are separate.

verification.method: Frozen audit_training/audit_tasks, canonical HDF5 endpoint reads, all artifact SHA256 comparisons, real Modal saved-call results and TaskGetInfo; no mocked provider boundary.

limitations: Three paired training seeds and one fixed 200-task/evaluation-seed suite.
Episodes are not independent training repetitions; reported SD uses the three training seeds (ddof=1).
No posthoc categorical collapse threshold; representation and loss diagnostics remain continuous.
These results do not establish general superiority or a robust rescue.
